notes.title: Pre-Order the Extremely Limited Dark Queen of Mortholme Shirt
notes.content:
Mournful day, citizens of Mortholme. 


We've heard your cries. Your outrage at our lack of...fabric. 

Your yearning for Mortholmian dress. 



It has arrived (in limited quantities) 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633797/9b78577dc5e6f9db4cbc3cb5ed8d3396513c833f.png"]

We've partnered with indie/local solo artist and clothier, Santiago Venegas, in developing a one-time run of The Dark Queen of Mortholme T-Shirt. 

Santiago is a long-time friend of Monster Theater, and travels all across the United States sharing his work from games and anime. We hope you enjoy this first-time collaboration between Monster Theater and Santiago's clothing brand! 


Pre-Order the Limited Press Here


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633797/891acaaa76d12287b69c464ef5861340d92676fe.png"]

We will also be doing a giveaway on the Monster Theater Discord, where you can enter and join for a shot at winning one of these illustrious pieces of queenly dress!

"You dare enter my domain...looking so good?"


Quick FAQ!

How limited are we talking?

This is almost like a friends and family print as a thank you for an incredible launch of the game on Steam! Pre-orders will run for a week or two, and then we will lock the print and ship the shirt to everyone who pre-ordered. 

How much is shipping?

There's a flat rate for orders shipped to the US and a different rate for international orders that is added to your price at checkout.

When will you ship?

Usually pre pre-orders will be open for a couple of weeks, and orders will start shipping out by the month after pre-orders close.

How quickly will I receive my order?

For domestic US orders, we calculate between 4 to 7 business days, and for international orders, around 10 to 15 business days.



Art designed by MOSU.

Extremely limited quantities available. 

Final product may differ.

notes.title: The Dark Queen of Mortholme is Steam Deck Verified!✅
notes.content:
ATTENTION, CITIZENS OF MORTHOLME!


After many perilous tests that endangered MANY of my servants, I'm surprisingly delighted to announce that the game featuring me, 'The Dark Queen of Mortholme', is now fully verified for Steam Deck. 



Please clap, or else! 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633797/d7de6c37bb38ec364aca5e7ac03f3a4ad79c9919.png"]

Is it not glorious?



Now you may unleash my wrath, crush the so-called Hero, and revel in conquest...wherever you may travel.


With eternal dominion,
The Dark Queen of Mortholme

notes.title: OFFICIAL DECREE FROM THE EMPRESS EVERLASTING
notes.content:
Official Decree from the Empress Everlasting
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633797/19357d91c5bb116c1230741bf45276a90598c2ab.png"]



A so-called “hero” has made themselves...known. They seek to breach my halls, to defile the sanctity of my throne room, and to bring an end to the age of my reign. 



You will not allow it. 

You will bar their passage at every gate, shadow them in every corridor, stamp out their bonfires.

Let this be known throughout Mortholme. 

Return them to the soil. 

Break their spirit. 

And should they rise again… break them once more. 



Thus speaks the Empress Everlasting.


The Dark Queen of Mortholme is out now.

notes.title: Atomic Owl is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
It is TIME, Bladewings! 

After three years in development, Atomic Owl is available now. You can add it to your Steam libraries, tell your friends about it, review it, unlock Steam achievements, or even speedrun the game!!

Experience a challenging platforming and combat experience where you must learn the world of Atomic Owl to progress. Hack and slash through hordes of Tengu using multiple avian weapons, equip devastating power-ups called Wing Remnants, and fly through a variety of challenging platforming levels in a rogue-lite made for the SNES era. 

Join our Discord here: https://discord.gg/Kj2wfmY7r3

Follow us here: https://monstertheater.carrd.co/

Thank you for letting us make games for you.

- Your friends at Monster Theater

PLEASE give it a review if you are enjoying the game~!

notes.title: Whispers from the Queen's Throne: July Update + Price Reveal
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633797/559051b3ddbbf47a378c7798b3fa04c39a2b5cbb.png"]

Artwork on the cover is by the talented Gresea!
Happy July, everyone! 
Eldar here from Monster Theater with a quick update on where we're at with The Dark Queen of Mortholme's Steam port. 

Well, first things first...

We recently put out a press release that outlines what you can expect from the game's launch and, of course, the price. 

The Dark Queen of Mortholme will launch at $5.99 (USD or local equivalent) with a 15% launch discount.

Now... 

How about a wishlist update...?
The Dark Queen of Mortholme has hit 60,000 wishlists!
Thank you ALL so much for showing us that you really, truly care about this short form indie. We can't wait for you all to experience the game again on Steam. 

We'd love to see you in the Monster Theater Discord, where you can join other fans of The Dark Queen of Mortholme!

https://discord.gg/Kj2wfmY7r3

Reminder that the Steam port will have the following:

Full Xbox and PlayStation controller support

Steam Cloud Support

Steam Achievements

A dozen added languages

Have you followed us on socials yet? Would love to see you on Twitter, Instagram, Threads, and BlueSky!

All of our socials are below.

https://monstertheater.carrd.co/ 


August 15th is only 25 days away! Have you wishlisted yet?


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633797/e83d65c31f23aca75fe12becf522b73c52d83bff.png"]

notes.title: Thank you for 20,000 wishlists!
notes.content:
In just a little over a week, you've helped us break the 20,000 wishlist barrier. That's amazing!

When Mosu and the Monster Theater team set out to bring The Dark Queen of Mortholme to Steam, we wanted to keep it faithful to the original itch.io release, but with a host of quality of life improvements, and we're beyond excited that the Steam community has found the game and is awaiting it's release. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633797/1327985fda6a17253adbcda79a2b93c184d63120.png

Here's what you can expect, as a reminder. 


 Full PlayStation and Xbox Controller support
 Steam Achievements
 Multiple Endings
 Steam Cloud 
 Over a dozen additional localized languages 

We can't wait for everyone to experience the story of the Dark Queen, and we hope you consider it a wonderful indie title to add to your Steam library. 

Thank you for supporting short-form indie games! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633797/559051b3ddbbf47a378c7798b3fa04c39a2b5cbb.png

Come say hi to the devs in the Discord~

You can also grab some amazing rewards over on our Patreon~

Be well,
Eldar and the Monster Theater team
